market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver reaching $120 by June 2026 would require an unprecedented >3x rally from current ~$30–35 levels in about 14 months, far exceeding the all-time high near $50. Even under extreme inflation or crisis scenarios, such a move is virtually impossible given the deep, liquid futures market and historical volatility. The market-implied 6.8% probability is drastically too high.
evidence_points: Current spot price ~$30–35 vs. target $120 (a ~3–4x increase needed).
Silver's all-time high is ~$50, making $120 a 2.4x multiplier over record.
The remaining time (≈14 months) leaves little window for a multi-standard-deviation structural price shift.
Non-event days and settlement methodology rule out intraday spikes; only official settlement prices count.
sources_consulted: CME historical settlement prices for SI futures
General knowledge of commodity market dynamics
